sources.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM mosaic, 20 m/px
sources.units: elevation meters (float32); projection meters (Equirectangular, Mars sphere)
sources.usageTerms: NASA/USGS publicly released science product; cite Mangold et al. 2021 (doi:10.1126/science.abl4051) per PDS4 label citation_information
sources.limitations: 20 m/px photogrammetric DEM; widths below one cell and smoothed steep faces are not resolved; slope on this grid is a planning proxy

sources.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX ortho mosaic, ~5 m/px
sources.usageTerms: NASA/USGS publicly released science product; same citation requirement
sources.limitations: grayscale radiance for alignment/texture, not calibrated reflectance

sources.usageTerms: publicly released PDS product; cite HiRISE/University of Arizona

assumptions.note: Every number below is a simulated planning assumption for the demo scenario. None is validated astronaut or life-support guidance.

entries.range: 10-30 deg sensible for a 20 m planning grid
entries.why: phase 1 connectivity-check parameter, kept as the routing threshold

entries.value: reserve = 20% of initial capacity per resource
entries.range: configurable 0-0.5; 20% is a demo value, not a NASA safety standard
10-120 min; uniform placeholder pending science input
20-80 m/min; representative of suited EVA paces in mission reports, not measured here

entries.value: +0.3 min per meter of net ascent
entries.range: 0-1 min/m; descent has no extra penalty in v1

entries.value: oxygen 0.2083/min, battery 0.2083/min (100 units / 480 min nominal EVA)
entries.range: rates must keep a full EVA inside 0-100 units

simulated: EVA budget parameters (initial resources, reserve fractions, stop durations, speeds, rates)
